title: On Fixing the Right Problems in Predictive Analytics: AUC Is Not the Problem
reasoning: The paper is a methodological critique of the AUC ROC metric within the context of predictive analytics for risk assessment (e.g., student dropout, recidivism). While it mentions fairness and algorithmic bias as motivations for using proper metrics, it does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical frameworks, nor does it involve Large Language Models (LLMs).
